Manifest.Name: Better Key Bindings
Manifest.Author: KCN-judu
Manifest.Description: Every key binding in the options menu takes key combinations such as Ctrl + E, the middle mouse button, mouse buttons 4 and 5, and the mouse wheel. A combination never also triggers the binding on its key alone. The key the game hard-codes for precise placement becomes a binding too. Choosing a key that is already in use asks whether to unbind the other binding.
